limitations: Two replicates per scenario and condition are descriptive, with no reliability or generalization estimate.
Model reason captures and reviews are self-reports. Actual release records and actual selected actions remain separate.
Images establish input equality only, not semantic identity or goal equivalence.
Only a subsequent audited observation establishes a performed action destination.
Mock scripted done output is a connectivity check and supplies no performance evidence.

Source, initial image, goal, persona, and config are paired with only config id and the declared correspondence component excluded. Actual model images, correspondence questions, and action annotations may differ.
Retrieved pixels and admitted links are model hypotheses, not verified semantic equivalence or human behavior. Pixel ranking only selects an image to compare.
The declared component bundles retrieval, an optional past image, correspondence questions and unchanged-link annotations; this comparison does not identify individual subcomponent effects.

Source matching checks saved observation references against actual asset metadata; it does not prove image interpretation, semantic accuracy or network delivery. Raw choices, rejected proposals, admitted unchanged/changed links, annotations and actual selected actions remain separate.

Newly attached unique-image counts are per request relative to current, recency and reason references; the same past image delivered to both stages is counted separately. The per-request unique-image maximum is reported independently.
No proposal or admitted link leaves correspondence accuracy untested, not demonstrated by a zero rejection count. Faulted runs remain excluded from valid-run outcome and behavior summaries.
